ai_summary: Here's a 3-sentence executive summary:  Amber Enterprises India Limited announced a significant leadership change at its material subsidiary, IL JIN Electronics (India) Limited, with Mr. Satendra Singh, a veteran in electronics manufacturing and global supply chain, appointed as the new CEO and Whole-Time Director. This strategic appointment is poised to leverage his extensive experience for growth, while the outgoing Whole-Time Director, Mr. Sanjay Kumar Arora, is transitioning to another role within the parent group, ensuring continuity. No immediate red flags are apparent, as Mr. Arora's departure from IL JIN is explicitly attributed to an internal group transfer, not performance or other material concerns.
